verdict.rationale: The only pricing evidence says registrations are charged at 'member-level rates' with no membership or API access fee. That is a discounted tier, not an at-cost or wholesale claim, and nothing shows a registry fee breakdown or a published low-margin guarantee. Community reports of 'overpriced domains' and prices 'inching up' further undercut any near-wholesale positioning.

support.subject: As a power user, pricing is at or near wholesale — at-cost claims backed by visible registry fee breakdowns or a published low-margin guarantee
